machine.shared: A development machine, with other work running at times; the A/B runs are alternated for that reason

build.tls: OpenSSL 3.6.5 (bundled, static: linux-ext-libs 1.26); mbedTLS not built on this machine
build.note: CONFIG_DEBUG_TRACK_MEMORY is on (the .config of this machine): every allocation is tracked. A build without it does less work per allocation; that build was not measured here.

method.ab: Written on 2026-10-27, before the tag. 7.28.8 is the C code of main at c717c9cd9, measured against 7.28.5, the last release with a study (7.28.6 and 7.28.7 changed the controlcenter and the scaffolding tools, which no benchmark runs). A short study: of what 7.28.8 changes in .c files, only json2gbuf() -- now checking the result of the dump -- is on the path of a benchmark, in every message between yunos, which perf_ievent runs; the machine trace (tab(), trace_machine()) runs only with a trace on, which no benchmark arms, and msg2db has no benchmark. So only perf_ievent was run. Each release built from a git worktree with the same .config, compiler and outputs_ext (linux-ext-libs 1.26: the 1.27 of this release changes only openresty, which no yuno links); the kernel libraries and the benchmark were built in each. The two binaries run in rotation, the order turned every round, with a sync and a 3 s pause before each run: 8 rounds. Mean +- standard deviation (median), t = the change over its standard error; |t| < 3 is noise.
method.tag_run: The absolute figure of 7.28.8 is its side of the A/B run: its C code (c717c9cd9), built on 2026-10-27 on the machine of the earlier reports.

story.title: Yuneta 7.28.8: errors said, at the same speed
story.lead: 7.28.8 makes a json that cannot be dumped whole say so, and stops msg2db freeing the defaults of its schema. Against 7.28.5, the one benchmark on that path stays inside its noise.
story.ab_sub: The benchmark built from the tree of each release (7.28.5 and 7.28.8), the binaries run in rotation: 8 rounds. Only the benchmark that runs changed code. A change inside its whisker is noise.
story.prices_sub: What got slower, how much, in which release, and what it buys.
story.abs_sub: Absolute figure of the 7.28.8 build (its C code: c717c9cd9), measured on 2026-10-27 as its side of the A/B run.
